opening.argument: The presentation identifies ordinary Dell laptops through a conventional QVC product order, with concrete models, selectable colors, stated prices, installment terms, and free shipping. The 15-inch option is offered for $769.98 or six payments of $128.33, while the 17-inch option is priced at $819.98 or $136.66 monthly, establishing a straightforward retail transaction rather than investment or data-access participation. The presentation also identifies included 24/7 PC support and antivirus protection, alongside an easy payment option and a 30-day return policy. These are specific hardware, service, payment, shipping, and return terms tied to a stated product listing, not promises of financial gain or access-based participation.
